content:
Build the n8n workflow JSON for the attached spec. Walk me through what you find in the spec and every decision you make as you go - I want to follow your working.

Attached file "payment-flow-spec.json" (application/json):
```
{
  "name": "Stripe payment -> HubSpot deal sync",
  "description": "When a Stripe payment succeeds, upsert the paying customer as a HubSpot contact and create a deal marked closed-won with the payment amount. Failures must go to a Slack #payments-alerts message.",
  "trigger": {
    "service": "stripe",
    "event": "payment_intent.succeeded"
  },
  "requirements": [
    "Idempotent: re-delivered Stripe events must not create duplicate HubSpot deals",
    "Map stripe customer email -> hubspot contact email (upsert)",
    "Deal name format: '<product> - <customer email>'",
    "Deal amount from payment_intent.amount (convert from cents)",
    "On any node failure, send Slack message to #payments-alerts with the Stripe event id"
  ],
  "notes": "The product name lives in payment_intent.metadata.product. If metadata.product is missing, decide a sensible fallback and flag it."
}
```

Two changes: use 'Ride Electric Subscription' as the product fallback instead of 'Unnamed Product', and only send the Slack alert for genuine failures - skip it when the duplicate check exits early. Tell me exactly what you changed.
